name: Women's Integrated Science and Health
description: WISH is an interdisciplinary organization dedicated to improving women's health through innovation, research, and collaboration, uniting students across disciplines to develop biotech tools and gain professional development opportunities.

name: Women's Lacrosse
description: We are in the Southern Women's Lacrosse League (SWLL). We are very competitive and play against the top teams in the country. Our goal each year is to compete at the WCLA National Tournament, through either an automatic qualifier bid or an at-large bid.

name: Women's Rugby Football Club at UGA
description: We are a SARC Division II club sport that competes throughout the Southeast. We work to foster a love of rugby through tough competition, team bonding, and community outreach.

name: Women's Studies Student Organization
description: We are a student organization focused on intersectional feminist dialogue and activism.

name: Women's Ultimate Frisbee
description: We are the Women's Club Ultimate Frisbee team

name: Workforce Education and Instructional Technology Graduate Association
description: Workforce Education and Instructional Technology Graduate Association (WEITGA), a graduate association committed to academic engagement, professional development, and collaborative partnerships among students, faculty, and community members.

name: Wrestling Club at UGA
description: The Wrestling Club at UGA exists to provide students an opportunity to wrestle at the college level. As a team registered with the NCWA, the Wrestling Club at UGA competes with small scholarship schools and other club level programs around the country.

name: WUOG 90.5FM
description: WUOG provides an alternative to other media outlets in the community through programming that is diverse and unique, serving the public with music, news, public affairs, sports of local and national interest, and other events both on and off-campus.

name: XChanged Life
description: XChanged Life fosters a community for current exchange students and UGA students passionate about travel and cross-cultural communication. Our mission is to cultivate a safe and inclusive environment where students can engage in cultural exchanges.

name: Xi Delta Sorority, Inc.
description: Xi Delta was founded at the University of Georgia in January of 1991. We are a diverse group of women focused on creating lifelong friends, supporting each other's endeavors, and fostering a sense of community through service.

name: Xi Kappa Asian-Interest Fraternity, Inc.
description: Xi Kappa Fraternity, Inc. is an Asian-interest fraternity committed to unwavering Brotherhood through its core values of Honor, Loyalty, and Respect.

name: Xtension
description: Xtension at UGA empowers African American students through mentorship, academic support, and community, fostering growth, success, and belonging.

name: Yoga Bhakti Club
description: We hold free yoga classes every Wednesday 6-7pm to practice svadhyaya (self-study), asanas, and pranayama! We aim to balance stress, promote a connection to self with mindfulness activities, and learn about yoga through practice and instruction.

name: Young Americans for Freedom
description: Young Americans for Freedom promotes the principles of limited government, individual freedom, free enterprise, a strong national defense, and traditional values by participating in a wide range of campus initiatives.

name: Young Americans for Liberty
description: Young Americans for Liberty at UGA was created to offer students a new political voice on campus. Our main goal is to educate, train, and mobilize our members with libertarian philosophy and to work toward a campus that gives a voice to all students.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America in Athens
description: Young Democratic Socialists of America in Athens is a youth chapter of the broader Democratic Socialists of America organization. Our goal is to create a resilient, active, and informed community work supporting mutual aid, labor unions, and more.

name: Young Democrats
description: The Young Democrats are dedicated to stimulating interest in government and politics, educating students on political issues and candidates, while advocating for a more progressive future! Follow us on Instagram @youngdemsuga for updated info!

name: Young Nonprofit Professionals Network at UGA
description: The YNPN - Athens chapter is dedicated to activate the next generation of emerging leaders in the social sector who currently study at UGA. YNPN vision: Stronger communities advanced by a diverse and powerful social sector.

name: Youth Movement Against Alzheimer's
description: To promote understanding of Alzheimer’s among youth and young adults by providing opportunities to help those affected by the disease.The vision of YMAA is to create a culture where youth embrace aging and alleviate the impact of Alzheimer’s.

name: Zeta Phi Beta
description: The Gamma Chi Chapter of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated was chartered February 11, 2024 at the University of Georgia by 11 women.

name: Zoological and Exotic Medicine and the American Association of Wildlife Veterinarians
description: The ZEW Med Club is a group of students based in the College of Veterinary Medicine interested in furthering their interest in zoo, exotic, and wildlife medicine through specialized meetings, wet labs, and conference participation.
